_doc: AC-2.1 anchor golden (design/adapters/openreview.md §7). Per-year {year, openreview_venueid|null, accepted_count, dblp_slug, dblp_toc_count, survey_approx_count, note}. STRUCTURE (year list + venueid case) is authoritative and asserted offline (tests/integration/test_openreview_acceptance.py). accepted_count (OpenReview venueid-filtered accepted count) is null = PENDING user token: [LIVE] 2026-07-22 the configured token was EXPIRED (401 TokenExpiredError — not a UA challenge, not a code defect; the cookie mechanism was server-validated correct), so the token-gated /notes sweep is BLOCKED pending a refreshed token. dblp_toc_count = [LIVE] 2026-07-22 count of `<li class="entry inproceedings">` on dblp.org/db/conf/iclr/iclr<year>.html (main-conference papers; the single `entry editor` = proceedings volume, excluded); populated for a representative subset (2013,2014,2015,2016,2024) — the remaining modern years' DBLP counts are deferred to the same session that unblocks the OpenReview accepted_count column (so both columns are captured together for the real cross-check). CORRECTION (supersedes prior draft + site-survey §9): DBLP DOES index iclr2015/iclr2016 (electronic edition @ iclr.cc, not openreview.net) — the survey's 'both sides missing 2015/2016' was falsified [LIVE]; OpenReview simply never hosted those two main conferences (2015 no conference group; 2016 only ICLR.cc/2016/workshop). survey_approx_count carries the site-survey §9 magnitude seed for reference ONLY.
